name: 120-endpoint-inside-a-pour-fill-region
why: The region is the axis-aligned square x in [10,20], y in [10,20] on bottom. The end cap sits at (15,15) — 5.000mm from each of the four edges — so the point is INSIDE the ring and the edge-to-edge gap is 0. This is containment, not proximity: the nearest edge is 40x further away than the 0.125mm cap radius, so no edge credit is involved. A trace end anywhere on a plane is on that plane.
